name: claude-mods
description: Zádori Olivér's Claude Code mods: a prompt-cache meter with keepwarm and a cold-cache guard, and a context row for the desktop app.

plugins.name: prompt-cache-control
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt with a details pane, /keepwarm pings after idle stretches, the price of a cold cache, and a guard that stops a cold send once.

plugins.name: context-band
plugins.description: A row above the prompt on the desktop app: working directory, git branch and the skill loaded since your last message.
